plan.hypothesis: two-group comparison: treatment mean ≠ control mean
assumptions: Gaussian response with random intercept per participant
4 observations per participant; complete data, no missing values
Marginal SD = 1 (population level)
ICC = 0.4
Constant mean difference between groups (constant treatment effect)
Groups equally allocated
Analysis: two-sided pooled t-test on participant averages at α = 0.05
Two-tailed test, equal variances
scientific_notes: Random-intercept model with between-group analysis on participant-level averages
The effective SD of participant averages depends on ICC and number of observations per participant
With ICC = 0.4 and m = 4 obs/participant: effective SD_avg = marginal_SD × √[ICC + (1−ICC)/m] = 1 × √[0.4 + 0.6/4] = √0.55 ≈ 0.7416
Two-sample t-test on n_per_group participants per group, df ≈ 2n − 2
Target: minimum integer n per group for 90% power
